title: Thermo-oxidative stability and flammability properties of bamboo/kenaf/nanoclay/epoxy hybrid nanocomposites
authors: Siew Sand Chee; Mohammad Jawaid; Othman Y. Alothman; Ridwan Yahaya
material_form: nonwoven bamboo mat/woven kenaf mat/epoxy laminate
material_form_TGA: nonwoven bamboo mat/woven kenaf mat/epoxy laminate
material_form_LOI: nonwoven bamboo mat/woven kenaf mat/epoxy laminate
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Bamboo/kenaf reinforced epoxy/nanoclay hybrid nanocomposite, layer-by-layer nonwoven bamboo mat and woven kenaf mat, hand lay-up laminate; experimental Tables 5/6
TGA_instrument: Mettler Toledo TGA1 thermogravimetry analyzer; ASTM E1131-03 (2003)
TGA_specimen_preparation: Source separately assays nanoclay powders and finished hybrid textile laminates. This row uses the laminate data in Tables 5/6, measured from 25 to 800 °C at 20 °C/min under source-reported oxygen atmosphere at 50 mL/min. Aliquot mass, cutting or grinding, pan, drying and through-thickness selection are unreported.
LOI_method: ASTM D2863 Type IV, ignition procedure A (top-surface candle-like ignition); oxygen concentration series, final LOI calculated as CF + k d from the last five measured burning outcomes, d=0.2 vol%; instrument model unreported
LOI_statistic: Source tabulated oxygen-index result from the ASTM concentration-series procedure; not described as a simple mean
LOI_specimen_preparation: Finished hybrid laminate cut into Type IV specimens, 100 × 6.5 × 3 mm. Each group has a set of 15 specimens; testing continued until the final five specimens obtained a 0.2 vol% oxygen-concentration deviation. Separate LOI conditioning is unreported.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Original publisher Tables 5/6 experimental laminate TG and Table 8 own measured oxygen-index result plus source standard deviation; table cells and original methods read directly from the publisher HTML. No curve coordinate extraction.
TG_locator: Tables 5/6; Thermo-oxidative decomposition behavior results; Characterization, Thermo-oxidative stability method
LOI_locator: Table 8; Characterization, Limiting oxygen index method and eqn 3; own LOI results paragraph and Figure 9 correlation discussion
conditions_locator: Materials Tables1/2; Preparation of natural fiber reinforced epoxy/nanoclay hybrid nanocomposites; Characterization
source_location: Complete original RSC publisher HTML: title through conclusions and 65 references, Tables 1–10 and figure captions. No full PDF-byte or figure-pixel claim.
washing_state: Initial cured and post-cured laminate; no durability wash, soil burial or weathering assigned
treatment_method: DGEBA epoxy DER-331 (Dow) and JOINTMINE 905-3s amine hardener were supplied by Tazdiq Engineering, Malaysia. Nanoclay was slowly dispersed in epoxy by mechanical stirring, then high-shear mixed with a T-25 Ultra Turrax homogenizer at 10000 rpm for 30 min in an ice bath and degassed for 30 min. Hardener was added slowly and hand-mixed; resin/hardener ratio is unreported in this original. Nonwoven bamboo mat (Shijiangzhuang Bi Yang Technology, China; source area density 0.8 kg/m²) and woven kenaf mat (ZKK, Malaysia; 0.6 kg/m²) were arranged layer by layer in a 240 × 120 × 3 mm stainless mold. Total fibre loading is source-reported 40%, with bamboo:kenaf 50:50; exact ply count/order is unreported. The mats were impregnated with the resin mixture and hand-rolled to remove bubbles, cured at room temperature for 24 h, then post-cured at 105 °C for 5 h. The unfilled control was made by the same method.
source_T10_definition: Table 5 labels T10% and the thermal-results prose calls it the initial decomposition temperature; no separate tangent onset is reported.
source_Tmax_definition: First and second decomposition steps represented by Tmax1/Tmax2 as temperatures of mass loss at the maximum rate; second is char oxidation-combustion.
source_residue_definition: Table 6 oxidation char residue from experimental laminate TG at 450/500/550/800 °C; no cone-residue conversion or component subtraction.
source_fiber_loading_raw: 40% total fibre; bamboo:kenaf50:50; current preparation text does not explicitly restate percentage denominator, earlier related abstract describes fibre loading by mass
source_nominal_nanoclay_loading_raw: 1 wt% loading introduced into epoxy/nanoclay mixture; denominator relative to resin mixture versus final laminate is not explicitly resolved
source_LOI_CF_d_unit_conflict: Table 8 labels CF and d as°C, while the own method explicitly defines both as oxygen concentration in vol%; raw table labels retained separately, not used as a temperature.
limitations: Four finished textile-laminate formulations are represented by the same source labels in the preparation, experimental TG Tables 5/6 and measured LOI Table 8. The source separately studies nanoclay powders and epoxy/nanoclay morphology; those component data are not substituted for the laminate TG. Oxygen atmosphere is retained as reported, without relabeling it as air. The source LOI is measured by an ASTM oxygen-concentration series; CF+k d is its standard series calculation. The later regression between char and measured LOI does not make these char-calculated LOIs. Table 8 explicitly reports standard deviations, but does not explain their averaging basis; the 15-specimen group and final 5-specimen sequence are preserved without inventing independent repetitions. Table 8 CF/d column units are incorrectly printed as°C while the methods define vol% oxygen. Whole-number LOIs 20/23/28 in narrative summaries are rounded descriptions; the precise Table 8 values are retained. Nanoclay fraction denominator, resin/hardener ratio, exact ply count/order, TG aliquot mass/pan/preparation and LOI conditioning are unreported. The preparation shares a broader bamboo/kenaf/epoxy family with earlier thermal/mechanical/weathering studies; their methods or numerical values are not transferred, and any future control reuse requires observation-specific review. The complete publisher HTML is available; PDF bytes and original figure pixels are unavailable. Thermal table values are transcribed, without estimating graph coordinates. The thermal prose difference of 60 °C between 495 and 434 is arithmetically imprecise; neither table temperature is altered. The cone TTI narrative/table mismatch is retained outside the TG–LOI extraction.
sample_state: B/K/epoxy; initial cured and post-cured textile laminate
composition: Source 40% total bamboo/kenaf reinforcement at 50:50 in DER-331/JOINTMINE 905-3s epoxy matrix; No added nanoclay
pairing_evidence: The same initial manufactured B/K/epoxy laminate is explicitly named in own experimental Tables 5/6 and own measured-LOI Table 8. Both assays follow the common laminate preparation. No different ply-count assay population or durability condition is introduced.
source_title: Thermo-oxidative stability and flammability properties of bamboo/kenaf/nanoclay/epoxy hybrid nanocomposites
